name: Axioma presale price business-logic flaw
summary: The Axioma presale contract sells AXT at a fixed rate that ignores the market price, so a flash loan could buy AXT cheaply in the presale and immediately dump it into the PancakeSwap pair.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
